data.name: Mallikarjun
data.gender_notes: Mallikarjun is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mallikarjun is the name of Lord Shiva, who is the protector and consort of Goddess Mallika, also known as Bhadrakali. The name is a combination of Mallika (Goddess) and Arjun (auspicious, heroic). The name Mallikarjun carries the meaning “Lord of the Goddess Mallika” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mallikarjun usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the goddess mallika and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the strength and protection of Lord Shiva and the grace of Goddess Mallika.
data.etymology: Mallikarjun belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Goddess Mallika.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mallikarjun total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Mallikarjun is an important deity in the Hindu mythology, particularly in the Indian states of Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. He is a part of the Shaiva tradition and is worshipped in various temple forms. Libations of rice-water, coconut water, and other offerings are made to Mallikarjun, and the devotees believe in receiving his blessings for prosperity, health, and a happy family life. The annual Mallikarjunjyoti festival, celebrated in the town of Siddhapura in Karnataka, is a notable event dedicated to this deity.
data.spiritual_significance: Mallikarjun represents the divine power that protects and preserves both the mundane and spiritual aspect of life. As a consort of Goddess Mallika, he symbolizes Shiva's protective role towards his devotees and the divine couple's mutual love and devotion. This spiritual significance is emphasized through the various rituals, mantras, and practices dedicated to Mallikarjun, which instill a sense of peace, protection, and inner strength in the devotees.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mallikarjun: Beloved of God Shiva, symbolizing deep devotion and surrender to the divine. The name evokes a sense of union with the supreme consciousness and the attainment of spiritual enlightenment.
